name: print-social-annual-business-conference-facebook-ad-line-portraits
title: '2024 Annual Business Conference' Facebook ad with a ruled info table and four line-art portrait tiles
whatItIs: A cream portrait ad on teal with a small square logo and company name, a ruled table row for the date ('MAY 04') and 'LIVE EVENT' tag beside the bold title, contact details in a second ruled row, and a 2x2 grid of red-and-teal duotone line-art portrait illustrations with a black 'connecting PEOPLE' tag overlapping the centre.
whatItMeans: Professional yet warm; hand-drawn line portraits soften a ruled, almost legalistic layout into something inviting.
techniques: Structure logistics as ruled table rows like a formal document.
Illustrate attendees as simple duotone line portraits.
Overlap a tag label across the seam of a photo/illustration grid.

vocabulary.definition: Content organised in a line-divided row like a form.
A face illustrated in outline using two colours.
